title: (READ DESCRIPTION!) Cxp_1139
description: You are in an experiment with a dark history. some want to save you, and some want you dead.
body:
# ### --READ THIS!-- so a few days ago my os corrupted and i had to reinstall it, well upon doing that i lost the workspace file. this mod will no longer be updated (sadly)


## JOIN THE DISCORD HERE! https://discord.gg/4ZEV3TYtCj ## 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Greetings, you have been randomly chosen to participate in Project CXP.
You will be tasked with many trials, such as entities you have not seen before.
Do not fear, they can not hurt you. ~~a̵s̵ ̶m̵u̷c̴h̶ ̷a̴s̸ ̷t̶h̸e̸y̷ ̸d̴i̷d̴ ̴t̷h̷e̵m̴~~.

Do be warned though as some of these entities may do the following things-
1. Shake your window
2. Create error popups on your device
3. Remove you from your "own world"
4. Ban you from your "own world"
5. Play (very) loud sounds
6. Grief the world (For experimental reasons)

This "version" can not and will not harm the device with malicious intent, ever.
You will have to survive 100 days in 1 world to complete the CXP 1139 challenge.
You will find things that may scare you, but there is nothing to be afraid of.
Besides, in the end it is all just a game. ~~there is nothing you can do to free them.~~

We do hope you enjoy CXP_1139. See you in there =)

~~there souls are trapped~~
